design_quote: We included randomised and non-randomised studies that directly compared interventions consisting of CDS
k_quote: Of 25 included studies, 20 were randomised and five were non-randomised.
reason: Mixed-design meta-analyses pooled randomised and non-randomised studies; subgroups were by RoB, setting and age, not design, so no RCT-only pooled synthesis is reported.
